_about: Unit Ready Room entries, keyed by lineage file name without .htm (e.g. 0501scbn). Each entry: year (the year the material is about, or null for ongoing), kind (Exhibit, Article, Photo, Video, Magazine, Memorial, Record, Association, Oral history, Document), title, url (relative links are to this lineage folder), source, and optional date and note. Entries are sorted by year on the page; order within a year is kept as written.
